

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
#| 




plot <-   targets::tar_read(participant_data) %>%
                mutate(groupSex = factor(groupSex, c("no", "yes"), c("No", "Yes"))) %>%
                group_by(groupSex) %>%
                summarize(count = n()) %>%
                ungroup() %>%
                filter(!is.na(groupSex)) %>%
                mutate(level = groupSex) %>%
                mutate(proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
    
                ggplot2::ggplot() + 
                            ggplot2::geom_bar(aes(x = level, fill = level, y = proportion), width = 1, stat = "identity") + 
                            ggplot2::geom_text(aes(x = level, label = count, y = proportion + 0.05), width = 1, stat = "identity") + 
                            ggplot2::theme_void() + 
                            ggplot2::theme(
                                            legend.position    = "none", 
                                            panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(size = 0.1),
                                            axis.text.x        = element_text(),
                                            axis.text.y        = element_text()
                                            ) + 
                            ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(
                                                                  dark_blue, 
                                                                  dark_pink, 
                                                                  dark_purple, 
                                                                  light_blue, 
                                                                  light_pink, 
                                                                  light_purple
                                                                  )
                              ) + 
                            ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
                            ggplot2::scale_y_continuous("Proportion of participants", labels = scales::percent) + 
                            ggplot2::theme(
                                          plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0, "cm"),
                                          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5 ),
                                          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(1, 0, 15, 0, "mm")),
                                          plot.caption = element_text(margin = margin(15, 0, 0, 0, "mm"), hjust = 0)
                                        ) + 
                            labs(
                                  title    = captions_and_titles("radargroupsex")$title,
                                  subtitle = captions_and_titles("radargroupsex")$subtitle,
                                  caption  = captions_and_titles("radargroupsex")$caption %>% str_wrap(95) %>% paste0("\n\n", captions_and_titles("common_caption") ) 

                                  )
  
apply_style_spacing_remainder(plot)
```
